serviceName: RaxCube online store on a subdomain (pre-production)
description: RaxCube's pre-production (staging) environment, identical to raxcube.com.store-subdomain but pointing into rax-cube.shop, where staging stores answer. Connects a subdomain the merchant already owns, such as shop.example.com, to their RaxCube online store. Always applied with the host parameter. Apply the groups separately: verify proves the subdomain is theirs, cname points the subdomain at the store.
variableDescription: %token%: the one-time ownership code RaxCube issued for this subdomain (32 hex characters); %target%: the RaxCube edge host the store answers behind, as a label under rax-cube.shop (for example customers)
